exactSupportingSpans.heading: PREFACE
exactSupportingSpans.quote: The technologies that make some forms of centralization less necessary may also make centralization more powerful.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: METHODOLOGICAL NOTE
exactSupportingSpans.quote: This is a work of disciplined speculation.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: PREFACE
exactSupportingSpans.quote: History provides analogies but not laws.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE MAP OF POSSIBLE FUTURES
exactSupportingSpans.quote: The central proposition of this book can be stated in one sentence: artificial intelligence may make smaller political units more administratively viable at the same time that it makes very large political units more powerful.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE MAP OF POSSIBLE FUTURES
exactSupportingSpans.quote: One company may provide the personal agent, identity layer, payment system, work marketplace, education, health navigation, insurance, reputation, and communication.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE RETURN OF THE CITY-REGION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: AI may lower the threshold further by providing legal, planning, translation, and analytical capacity to regions that previously lacked it.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE RETURN OF THE CITY-REGION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Wastewater may require a watershed authority. Transit may need a metropolitan region.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE RETURN OF THE CITY-REGION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: If the same official model writes the proposal, summarizes criticism, predicts impacts, and recommends the final choice, participation becomes ceremonial.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE RETURN OF THE CITY-REGION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Local democracy in the AI era therefore requires epistemic separation: opposition, media, civil society, universities, and courts need independent cognitive tools.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE POLITICAL ECONOMY OF THE CITY-REGION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Conversely, a rich region that keeps all locally generated revenue while benefiting from a common market, defense, currency, universities, migration, and national infrastructure is not autonomous so much as subsidized by the larger system.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE POLITICAL ECONOMY OF THE CITY-REGION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: A federation pools those risks.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE DARK SIDE OF FRAGMENTATION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: The owner may never use spectacular coercion because dependency does the work.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE DARK SIDE OF FRAGMENTATION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Rivers, air basins, forests, grids, coastlines, and migration corridors cross local boundaries.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: THE DARK SIDE OF FRAGMENTATION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Polycentric environmental governance works when overlapping authorities can negotiate and when higher levels can act against persistent externalization.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A CONSTITUTION OF RESILIENCE
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Functions are assigned according to externality, required scale, and the value of local knowledge.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A CONSTITUTION OF RESILIENCE
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Critical public functions should have substitutable providers, multiple implementations, offline or degraded modes, and documented exit plans.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A CONSTITUTION OF RESILIENCE
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Institutions that decide, execute, prosecute, judge, inform, and audit should not depend completely on the same model or data pipeline.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A CONSTITUTION OF RESILIENCE
exactSupportingSpans.quote: A common standard should not require one product.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: CONCLUSION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: The deepest case for fragmentation is epistemic humility.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: CONCLUSION
exactSupportingSpans.quote: The deepest case for federation is moral and strategic realism.

artMeaning: A real bus pulls into an inhabited supported shelter, while a modest planning room considers the route. Shared electricity and neighboring settlements widen the frame from one useful local service to interdependence. A hypothetical orientation, not a real city or a claim that AI has already improved its transport.

A resident and planner compare a proposed bus route with the retained original. The planning aid and service kiosk depend on one outside provider. A visibly labeled dependency test makes both interfaces unavailable while physical people, map and urban service persist. No named vendor misconduct, actual deployment or automatic route approval.

A river basin crosses a marked jurisdiction boundary. A hypothetical rainfall pulse travels downstream without depicted catastrophe or a border stopping it. Residents from both communities bring observations and a modest maintenance contribution to shared monitoring; no automatic protection, invented flood quantity or new engineering method.

A documented original route and independent tool support explicitly limited service during the hypothetical dependency test. A civic reviewer receives the retained request through a separately supplied tool; the decision remains open. An overhead reading table ends on the actual chapter map and constitution, keeping the original route beside the book.
epistemicLimits: Transit/connection failure and river-basin scenes are explicitly hypothetical illustrations, not named historical events or empirical forecasts.
An AI route is proposed and compared, not automatically safe, fair, implemented or superior.
No claim that smaller government is naturally democratic or that states necessarily disappear.
The outside provider’s unavailable connection illustrates dependence without alleging misconduct by a real company.
No invented catastrophe, hydrological quantity, flood-defense design or immediate guarantee of safety.
Fallback service is partial and proposed; independent review remains unresolved.
Common rights, fiscal solidarity and shared infrastructure remain substantive conditions of the preferred scenario.
figureReview: Only source image is the cover, inspected. Its split utopian/dystopian city-tree scene is cover symbolism, not evidence or a body diagram. The original transit office and shared river-basin scenes replace icon geography with actual source-supported service/dependency functions.
